Arthur Pendelton
Principal Technical Program Manager (TPM)
San Jose, CA | arthur.pendelton@tpmmail.com | +1 408-555-0199 | linkedin.com/in/arthurpendelton-tpm

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Results-driven Principal Technical Program Manager with 10+ years of experience leading multi-million-dollar cross-functional engineering initiatives, global cloud migrations, and distributed infrastructure programs. Expert at aligning C-suite strategy with technical execution, identifying critical path dependencies, mitigating technical risks, and managing stakeholder communication across 200+ engineers in fast-paced enterprise environments.

WORK EXPERIENCE
Principal Technical Program Manager | HyperScale Cloud Corp | San Jose, CA | 2020 - Present
- Led cross-functional cloud modernization program spanning 18 engineering teams, migrating 450+ microservices to AWS and saving $4.2M annually in data center operational costs.
- Defined technical roadmap, dependency mapping, and risk mitigation strategies for enterprise zero-trust security rollout across 25,000 corporate endpoints.
- Orchestrated executive steering committee updates, KPI tracking, and technical governance for a $28M strategic portfolio, delivering 95% of milestones on schedule.
- Established standardized TPM operational frameworks, technical specification templates, and Jira roadmapping practices across 6 global product divisions.
- Resolved high-impact cross-team blockers and architectural conflicts, accelerating enterprise release cadence by 45%.

Senior Technical Program Manager | NextGen Networks | Sunnyvale, CA | 2016 - 2020
- Managed global optical networking infrastructure upgrade program valued at $15M across 14 international data centers ahead of schedule.
- Partnered with Hardware, Firmware, and Software engineering leads to align sprint roadmaps, hardware fabrication timelines, and customer betas.
- Reduced project change request turnaround time by 50% through automated risk management and change-control board (CCB) workflows in Confluence.
- Mentored and coached 8 junior and mid-level Technical Program Managers across the organizational unit.

EDUCATION
Master of Science in Electrical Engineering & Computer Science | Stanford University | 2014 - 2016
Bachelor of Science in Computer Engineering | University of California, Davis | 2010 - 2014

TECHNICAL SKILLS
- Program & Project Leadership: Program Lifecycle Management, Critical Path Analysis, Roadmap Planning, Risk Management, Stakeholder Engagement, Agile/Scrum/Waterfall
- Technical Domains: Cloud Architecture (AWS, Azure), Microservices, Distributed Systems, Data Center Infrastructure, API Integrations, InfoSec Compliance
- Tools & Software: Jira, Confluence, Asana, SmartSheet, MS Project, Tableau, GitHub, Figma, Miro
- Governance & Methodologies: SDLC Governance, RACI Matrix, OKR Setting, Budgeting ($20M+), Vendor Management

CERTIFICATIONS
- Project Management Professional (PMP) - PMI (2018)
- PMI Agile Certified Practitioner (PMI-ACP) (2020)
- AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner (2021)
jobDescriptionText:
Seeking a Principal Technical Program Manager to drive complex cloud infrastructure programs. Requirements:
- 8+ years experience as a Technical Program Manager in cloud or distributed software environments.
- Proven experience driving multi-million-dollar programs with cross-functional engineering teams.
- Strong technical background in cloud computing, risk mitigation, and dependency mapping.
- PMP or PMI-ACP certification preferred.
